fusions.name: Raw Force Detonation
fusions.desc: Hurls a knot of raw force that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Unravelling Blow
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more for each one, and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Force Beyond Reach
fusions.desc: After a half-second charge, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Mana Into Muscle
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
